note: The session's shared web-search allowance was already used up (200 of 200) when this part began, so no candidate could be searched for; only official pages at addresses known or linked from a government home page were read. Many county, city and party sites did not resolve (Woodford County, Pendleton County, Lyndon, the Nelson County Democrats, the Kentucky Party) and Elizabethtown's site showed a certificate for another host, so they were not read. The Hardin County Republican Party lists Tim Isaacs for Elizabethtown council with a Facebook link only (a social profile, not a website; support listing already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json). The 28 other candidates were left blank. Verifier: both official pages re-opened on 2026-10-03; each names the person in the same Kentucky city and seat sought in 2026 (Hopkinsville Ward 6; Richmond Board of Commissioners).
